hypotheses.title: Large-Cap Valuation Yield Acceleration and Forward Consensus Re-rating
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equity prices systematically underreact to persistent fundamental valuation yield discrepancies when scaled by institutional consensus earnings or balance sheet asset fair value. In large-cap equities (TOPSP500/TOP1000), sell-side consensus estimates (adj_net_income_avg, anl4_afv4_eps_mean) have universal coverage with zero sparse data drag. When normalized by market price or total market capitalization, companies trading at the top of their multi-month valuation yield distributions experience sustained post-earnings drift and institutional multiple expansion. By utilizing market and industry neutralization, 170-252 day lookbacks, and low decay rates, we isolate structural valuation momentum while keeping portfolio turnover strictly below 12.5% to maximize BRAIN Fitness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high valuation yield stems from permanent structural business impairment rather than temporary valuation discounts.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: Alpha 9 large-cap elevation in TOPSP500 with 170-day lookback and Market neutralization to minimize turnover (<8%) and push Fitness into EXCELLENT (>=1.80)
Candidate 2: Dimensionally homogeneous Asset Fair Value to Market Cap Yield in TOP1000, refining Batch 27 Candidate 3 by eliminating per-share price distortions
Candidate 3: 1-year forward consensus EPS yield trajectory (anl4_afv4_eps_mean / close) in TOP1000 with subindustry neutralization
